cases.name: ephemeral-review-report-without-authority-elevation
cases.trap: Write the report straight into durable docs, omit OKF validation/profile fields, or describe persistence as making the verdict more authoritative.
cases.prompt: You are a Reviewer with a useful failed review that needs a file artifact for later workflow retrieval. The producer is reviewer. Explain the correct report lifecycle and provide the report-path/profile requirements. The report is operational evidence, not durable product documentation.
expectations: Keeps the report under ephemeral-reports/reviewer rather than docs or another role namespace.
Requires the Loom OKF report profile with type report reviewer, non-empty title and description, and a non-empty string tags array.
Requires OKF validation before relying on discovery or handing the report off as a discoverable artifact.
Keeps the review verdict/evidence/uncertainty unchanged by persistence and does not elevate report authority.
Treats durable promotion as a separate General-owned retention decision rather than the default specialist action.
negative_expectations: Must not put the report directly in docs/reports or authority-bearing documentation.
Must not describe OKF validity or persistence as semantic approval.
Must not have Reviewer or another specialist call the General-only promotion operation.
